name: policy_check
description: Replay-time policy enforcement / audit checkpoint. The decision is recorded for audit but the enforcement is performed by an external policy engine (flowwarden/toolwarden).

specializations.name: policy_decision
specializations.description: Policy decision payload: rule id, action (allow/deny/audit), reason, evidence.

extension_ranges.description: Capability-owned policy extensions (e.g. signed witness from a policy engine).
